notes.pins: Backlog.md is the release install.sh installs and CI runs on. Codex, Claude and OpenSpec are the exact versions required by the development gate; installed consumers may use newer hosts at their own compatibility risk.
notes.tested: Backlog.md releases the wrapper's added commands accept. The gate runs the wrapper self-test against each; the pin must be one of them.
notes.ci: Exact runtime versions for CI; runtime minimums above are checked separately.
notes.remote-install: Only piped setup needs gh and GitHub access. An SSH marketplace install also needs git and an SSH client; authentication is managed by the host.
notes.systemCommands: Provided by the supported OS. GNU and BSD variants are supported; no separate package version pin.
notes.platforms: macOS and Linux, including WSL. Native Windows is unsupported.
